utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help organize the repair drive and keep track of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara. I’m a bit late, but I can take on one of the repair tasks too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane. Take the one you’re best at, and I’ll keep the list straight so we know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What time should I come by, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What about 10 am? Just bring a screwdriver and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a spare box of screws and some duct tape we can bring over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Nice, that should help. I’ll swing by with the screws and tape too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then let’s make sure we don’t double up on anything else. I’ll grab the nails and a pry bar too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need a clear schedule and someone to keep the list straight before we start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll put the schedule in order and keep the list updated while we work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the exact time, but I heard it starts soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know where it is being held?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few extra hands at the repair drive. If you’ve got time, Gus, it’d be a good day to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can swing by and lend a hand for a while.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that’ll help a lot. I’ll tell folks you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading to the repair drive after lunch, and you should come by if you can spare a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can do that if I finish up early. Which spot are you meeting at?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m at the corner lot by the old community hall. If you’re running late, just look for the tables and the tool boxes out front.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you can?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I’m sure. I said I’d help, and I will.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything needs a quick hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to help. Let’s keep it simple and figure out what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll help figure out what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I meant to ask if you still need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use a little help, if you don’t mind. I’m trying to keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, of course. Point me at the part that needs doing, and I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. What still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Pretty much just hauling supplies and checking who still needs tools. If you know anyone with a spare drill, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around for a spare drill and point anyone with one your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive already. I’ll make sure Dane hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn. I’m in late, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let you know the details and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d appreciate that. If you’ve got time, let’s start with the drive and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, let’s take a look together and see what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need to check the school pickup time first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No rush, Faye. I’ll keep the repair drive in mind and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara. I’ll check after pickup and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want. I know a few folks who’d be happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules. I’ll keep that in mind and let people know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, a few wrenches, and some clamps if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s generous, but do you have anything for measuring and a way to keep the parts sorted? I’m worried we’ll lose time hunting for the right piece.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a tape measure and a couple of bins; I’ll bring them so we can keep everything in order.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track that down, Rosa. Where did the repair drive end up being stored?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I think it was stored in the basement utility room by the back stairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that gives me a solid place to check first. I’ll start with the basement utility room by the back stairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need about $200 for the parts and labor.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I still need screws, a drill battery, and some replacement brackets.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. I’ll bring over some screws and a drill battery, and I’ll check on the brackets too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think they’re collecting tools and parts this week, but I missed the exact drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out for the drop-off details and let you know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s still on. We’re collecting a few more names, then the list goes out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, just checking - you’re sure the list isn’t closed yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can swing by later and see if they still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thanks. I can use the extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll stop by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. I was meaning to check on that, but I think I mislaid the details. What’s the next step?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem. I’ll check the list and let you know the next step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo. I’ll wait for the list and then I’ll get on it.
